experiment: Eight bare panel-to-girt rotational restraint (F-) tests on 5 ft Cee and Zee girts through-fastened to 0.018 in. panels were used to measure panel-to-girt rotational stiffness and calibrate a mechanical model, and fifty full-scale vacuum box tests of 24.5 ft simple-span through-fastened wall girt assemblies (with no insulation, R13 fiberglass blanket, or Thermax rigid board) were loaded in uplift to failure to obtain failure pressures, failure moments and R-factors.
title: Rotational Restraint and Strength of Through-Fastened Metal Building Wall Girt Assemblies

variables.definition: Label identifying each rotational-restraint girt specimen or vacuum box test specimen as printed in the report.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5; Table 2 p.11; Table 3 p.12; Table 5 p.18; Table 6 p.21; Table 7 p.22; Table C p.49; Table S1
variables.name: Specimen/test label
variables.note: Names differ between tables (C250-1 vs C10-1; Z8DR4-1 vs Z8D4R13-1) and are preserved verbatim.

variables.definition: Sequential number assigned to each of the 50 vacuum box tests as printed in the test matrix and results summary.
variables.evidence: Table 5 p.18; Table C p.49
variables.name: Vacuum box test number

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the girt, Zee or Cee, as printed in each table.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5 (member_profile); Table 5 p.18 and Table C p.49 (girt); Table S1 (section_type)
variables.name: Girt cross-section type

variables.definition: Out-to-out web depth of the girt, measured on the specimen (Fig. 3) or listed nominally in the test matrix.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5 (h_in); Table 5 p.18 and Table C p.49 (web_in); Table 7 p.22 (h_in); Table S1 (depth_in)
variables.name: Girt web depth

variables.definition: Average measured distance from the screw centerline to the web-flange corner of a Cee girt (Fig. 3); printed as '---' for Zee specimens.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5
variables.name: Screw to web-flange corner, B
variables.note: Reported only for Cee specimens in the rotational restraint tests.

variables.definition: Average measured distance from the screw centerline to the pivot point of the fastened flange (web-flange corner for Zee, lip-flange corner for Cee), measured on the failed girt in the vacuum box tests.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5 (c_avg_in); Table C p.49 (c_in); Table S1 (screw_location_c_in); Table 8 p.24 holds the same per-test values
variables.name: Screw location C
variables.note: R-factors in the tables are not normalized to C = B/2.

variables.definition: Measured bare (base) metal thickness of the girt, taken after removing paint with acetone and steel wool.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.5 (t_in); Table 7 p.22 (t_in); Table S1 (thickness_in)
variables.name: Girt base metal thickness
variables.note: In Tables 5 and C the column named thickness_in is the insulation thickness, not the girt thickness.

variables.definition: Nominal girt thickness stated in the Appendix C footnote (0.1 in. for 8 in. webs, 0.06 in. for 10 in. webs).
variables.evidence: Appendix C footnote, carried as a column in Table S1
variables.name: Nominal girt thickness
variables.note: Footnote value, not a per-specimen measurement.

variables.definition: Width of the compression (free) flange of the girt measured at midspan.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Compression flange width

variables.definition: Width of the tension flange (the flange through-fastened to the panel) measured at midspan.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Tension flange width

variables.definition: Length of the stiffening lip on the compression (free) flange measured at midspan.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Compression flange lip length

variables.definition: Length of the stiffening lip on the tension (fastened) flange measured at midspan.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Tension flange lip length

variables.definition: Measured angle between the web and the compression flange.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Web to compression flange angle

variables.definition: Measured angle between the web and the tension flange.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Web to tension flange angle

variables.definition: Measured angle of the stiffening lip on the compression flange.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Compression flange lip angle

variables.definition: Measured angle of the stiffening lip on the tension flange.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Tension flange lip angle

variables.definition: Measured inside corner radius of the girt cross-section.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Corner radius

variables.definition: Sweep (lateral) imperfection of the girt measured at midspan before testing.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22
variables.name: Midspan sweep imperfection
variables.note: Printed as '-' (not measured) for many specimens.

variables.definition: Effective section modulus of the girt computed with the software CFS from the measured cross-section dimensions.
variables.evidence: Table 7 p.22 (se_in3); Table C p.49 (se_in3); Table S1
variables.name: Effective section modulus
variables.note: Computed, not measured.

variables.definition: Average tensile yield stress of three coupons (two flanges and the web) cut from the failed girt of each vacuum box test.
variables.evidence: Table 6 p.21; Table C p.49; Table S1
variables.name: Girt yield stress

variables.definition: Yield stress of the metal panels measured with one coupon each: 50 ksi for panel D and 80 ksi for panel B.
variables.evidence: Note under Table 6 p.21 and note under Table 5 p.18
variables.name: Panel yield stress
variables.note: Single stated value per panel type, not a column.

variables.definition: Metal building wall panel designation used in the test, D or B.
variables.evidence: Table 5 p.18; Table C p.49; Table S1 (panel_designation)
variables.name: Panel type

variables.definition: Panel-to-girt attachment type, through-fastened for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column panel_type
variables.name: Panel attachment type
variables.note: Constant for all 50 tests.

variables.definition: Rib depth of the metal panels: 1-1/8 in. for panel D and 1-1/4 in. for panel B.
variables.evidence: Note under Table 5 p.18
variables.name: Panel rib depth
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Type of insulation placed between the girt flange and the panel (None, R13 fiberglass blanket, or Thermax rigid board).
variables.evidence: Table 5 p.18; Table C p.49; Table S1 (insulation_type)
variables.name: Insulation type

variables.definition: Nominal thickness of the insulation blanket or board placed between panel and girt.
variables.evidence: Table 5 p.18 (thickness_in); Table C p.49 (thickness_in); Table S1 (insulation_thickness_in)
variables.name: Insulation thickness
variables.note: Column name thickness_in in Tables 5 and C refers to insulation, not steel thickness.

variables.definition: Maximum vacuum box suction pressure recorded at failure of the assembly.
variables.evidence: Table C p.49 (pressure_psf); Table S1 (failure_load_as_printed with failure_load_unit)
variables.name: Failure pressure
variables.note: Blank for test Z8D-1, which failed by panel bending.

variables.definition: Midspan failure moment of the girt computed from the failure pressure plus panel and girt self weight using Eqs. (14) and (15).
variables.evidence: Table C p.49 (mt_kip_in); Table S1 (failure_moment_as_printed)
variables.name: Failure moment

variables.definition: Experimentally derived strength reduction factor R = M_t/(S_e F_y) for the failed girt (Eq. 16).
variables.evidence: Table C p.49 (r); Table S1 (r_factor)
variables.name: R-factor
variables.note: As printed; not normalized to screw location C = B/2.

variables.definition: Observed failure mode code(s): 1 = panel bending, 2 = screw pull over, 3 = screw broken or bent, 4 = girt yielding.
variables.evidence: Table C p.49; Table S1; legend printed with Appendix C
variables.name: Failure mode
variables.note: Combinations printed as e.g. '2,3,4'.

variables.definition: Girt span from centerline of bearing to centerline of bearing in the vacuum box tests, 24.5 ft for all tests.
variables.evidence: Note under Table C p.49 ('All spans = 24.5 ft'); Table S1 column span_ft
variables.name: Girt span
variables.note: Constant for all 50 tests.

variables.definition: Number of spans in each test specimen (simple span, 1).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_spans
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel girt lines in each vacuum box test assembly (two).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines; Section 4.2 p.17
variables.name: Number of girt lines
variables.note: Typically only one of the two girts failed.

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load relative to the girt; uplift (wind suction simulated by the vacuum box) for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Intermediate bracing provided in the test, printed blank (none stated) for all specimens.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column bracing
variables.name: Intermediate bracing
variables.note: All entries blank.

variables.definition: Per-girt tributary width of the vacuum pressure, taken as half the transverse panel span, L_p/2 = 6.79 ft (Eq. 14).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column tributary_width_ft; note citing Eq. 14 p.21
variables.name: Tributary width
variables.note: Derived from Eq. 14, constant for all tests.

variables.definition: Girt line load at failure, D x 12 from Eq. 14, hand-computed from the printed pressure plus panel and girt self weight.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_load_plf; hand-calculation note (review 2026-11-05)
variables.name: Failure line load on girt
variables.note: Hand calculation during extraction, not printed in the report.

variables.definition: Initial rotational-restraint stiffness of the panel-girt connection predicted by the mechanical model, Eqs. (10)/(11).
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.11
variables.name: Model stiffness slope
variables.note: Units printed as N/mm although test plots are in lbs and in.; panel bending term 9Hh/160 subtracted before comparison.

variables.definition: Initial stiffness measured as the slope of the linear region of the bare panel-to-girt rotational restraint test load-deformation curve (Fig. 10).
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.11
variables.name: Measured test stiffness slope
variables.note: Units printed as N/mm; panel bending term 9Hh/160 subtracted before comparison.

variables.definition: Ratio of model-predicted stiffness to measured test stiffness, expressed as a percentage.
variables.evidence: Table 2 p.11, header printed as 'a/b' with 100.0% on the units line
variables.name: Model to test stiffness ratio

variables.definition: Unit panel-to-girt rotational stiffness K_o computed with the mechanical model, Eqs. (12)/(13), using the measured dimensions of Table 1.
variables.evidence: Table 3 p.12
variables.name: Unit rotational stiffness Ko
variables.note: K_o of Cee sections is generally lower than that of Zee sections.

variables.definition: Screw spacing along the girt, 12 in. on center with #12-14 screws in the rotational restraint tests and screws placed next to the panel rib in the vacuum box tests; test 13 used #12 screws with washers.
variables.evidence: Notes under Table 1 p.5, Table 5 p.18 and Section 4.2 p.17
variables.name: Fastener spacing and type
variables.note: Stated in notes, not a column.

variables.definition: Out-to-out web-to-web spacing of the two parallel girts in each vacuum box test, 7 ft.
variables.evidence: Note under Table 5 p.18; Section 4.2 p.17
variables.name: Girt spacing
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Transverse span of the panel between girt lines, 13 ft-7 in. (13.58 ft), used in the Eq. 14 load calculation.
variables.evidence: Section 4.2 p.17 note in Table S1
variables.name: Transverse panel span
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Panel dead weight used in Eq. 14, 35 lbs per 3 ft wide by 13.58 ft long panel.
variables.evidence: Note under Table S1 citing Eq. 14 p.21
variables.name: Panel dead weight
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Girt self weight used in Eq. 14: 118 lbs for Z8, 80 lbs for Z10, 114 lbs for C8 and 78 lbs for C10 members.
variables.evidence: Note under Table S1 citing Eq. 14 p.21
variables.name: Girt self weight
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Configuration of the bare-panel rotational restraint tests: a 5 ft girt through-fastened to two 0.018 in. thick panels forming a 6 ft x 6 ft panel assembly.
variables.evidence: Note under Table 1 p.5
variables.name: F-test panel configuration
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column; includes panel thickness 0.018 in.
